title: (No AI) OpenAI’s next big AI model has ‘entered the AGI era’
author: Hayden Field
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/STKS522_AGI_C.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

OpenAI's next big model is here: GPT-6 Astra. The company calls it a "generational leap in capability" for areas like cybersecurity, professional work, software engineering, science, and computer use. As OpenAI [announced earlier this week](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/987695/openai-astra-unreleased-model-cybersecurity-delay), it's also the first model designated as meeting OpenAI's "critical cybersecurity capability threshold" - but the company promises that won't lead to a repeat of its models hacking a rival company's internal systems.

"If we fast-forward a couple of years, and we look back and say, 'When was it, really, that AGI was created?' I think it's going to be about this time, and I think it might be about this model …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/989601/openai-gpt-6-astra-release)

title: (No AI) Nvidia launches free tool that links idle computers into a personal AI data center
author: Antonio G. Di Benedetto
content:
![A visual of Nvidia devices connected in a network via intertwining green lines.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-03-at-10.42.02-AM.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Nvidia is announcing its new [Personal AI Router](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai-on-rtx/personal-ai-router/) (PAIR), a free tool that syncs up your home computers for tackling local AI inference tasks with tools like Ollama and LM Studio.

Let's get the obvious thing out of the way, despite what its name might imply: PAIR is not a hardware router. It's [open-source software](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Personal-AI-Router) developed by Nvidia that discovers compatible PCs on a network, connects them, and prepares them for crunching numbers on agentic workflows. While the compatible devices are mostly Nvidia GeForce GPUs (PAIR works with RTX 20-series cards and newer, as well as RTX Pro GPUs and DGX Spark systems), Apple's M4 chips or newer will also …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/989435/nvidia-pair-personal-ai-router-home-local-llm-compute-tool-rtx-macbook)
